title: Fredag
about: A piece for the mountains, above ground. It is written for its biome as it stands, so every fader is 0 dB in the open air. The game keeps playing it when the player goes underground, and it is meant to stand that; the 'cave' hint only thins the sustained strings and glass, the lanes the cave reverb smears first. The roles say what each lane does.

roles.lead: the tune: the soft synth, the cor anglais when it sings the tune again (bars 26–29), and the floating island's tune on glass (bars 24–25): keep it
roles.foundation: the piano: the tables' five strokes a bar, the climbs and slips on the cliffs, the sinking bass under the overhang, the valley's low A: the pulse and the floor: keep it
roles.bed: the strings (a soft bed on the tables, the heavy held chord of the overhang) and the island's glass chord: sustained, the first to smear under the cave reverb (the strings have nothing under 200 Hz)

lanes.label: Island
lanes.note: only in bars 24–25: the tune a comma (23 cents) above the ground; nothing else plays under it

lanes.label: Glass 1
lanes.note: the island (bars 24–25) and the far island (bars 32–34)

lanes.label: Glass 3
lanes.note: the island (bars 24–25) and the far island (bars 32–34)
